item.description:
• Fixed: Auto-Blast could stop engaging, leaving the fans low while the Mac ran hot. The fan helper keeps running across MacBreeze updates and restarts, and could hold on to an older safety temperature instead of the one showing in Safety. MacBreeze now checks that they agree and corrects the helper while it runs.
  • The fan helper now updates along with MacBreeze, instead of asking for your password to reinstall it by hand after some updates. This is also what left it holding stale settings in the first place.
  • App Automations now show what is happening, not just what each rule is set to do. The rule driving the fans is highlighted, and an app that is running but outranked by a rule above it is outlined rather than looking closed.
  • The What's New window no longer opens behind the dashboard, where it left the window in front looking blurred for no visible reason.
  • The update window now opens in the middle of the screen, like the rest of MacBreeze's windows.
  • The menu bar panel now closes when you click MacBreeze's own window, instead of staying open on top of it.
  • The active profile is easier to pick out in the Profiles list.

• The menu bar readout has a Compact setting: the same readings in smaller type, for a menu bar that is already full. MacBreeze's own icon can be hidden too, leaving just the numbers.
  • Right-click the menu bar icon for quick actions: Blast, Open Dashboard, Quit.
  • Clicking the menu bar icon no longer flashes a dark box behind it.
  • MacBreeze can leave the Dock while its window is closed, so it lives in the menu bar alone. Turn it off in Preferences if you want the Dock icon and app menu always there.
  • Blast no longer makes the fan mode picker jump to Auto. Your setting stays on screen and comes back when Blast ends.
  • Each fan's real speed now stays visible while an app automation is running.
  • Descriptions under settings no longer run underneath the switch they describe.
  • In your licence's device list, "This Mac" and the Mac that manages the licence are now marked in colour.
• A profile with a description no longer takes up half again as much room as the others — the description now sits beside the profile's name.
